title: migrations/ dir empty but CLAUDE.md says it contains SQL files
description: The /migrations directory contains only a .gitkeep. All migration SQL lives inline in crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs as Rust string literals. CLAUDE.md architecture table says 'migrations/ - SQLite migration files' which is misleading: reviewers waste time looking in the wrong place. Either move SQL to .sql files embedded via include_str\!, or remove the directory and correct CLAUDE.md.
